answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent id earn its vote through a slashable escrow of work. A fresh id climbs the knoll of the ledger weightless, publishing signed, replayable compute proofs peers rerun themselves. Trust rises and falls like the tide of attested labor: an attester who vouches for a fake forfeits a locked stake, so endorsement is never free. Like a hardy juniper on stone, honest reputation roots slowly, while cloned wallets stay weightless at the ballot, epoch after epoch.
